segments.name: Professional weather + remote property monitoring
segments.thesis: Cabins, farms, coastal/remote properties create country-specific monitoring/maintenance demand; specialist decision support may be weaker than availability.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic monitoring doesn't address remote-ownership problem specifically

segments.name: Hytte remote systems
segments.thesis: Large leisure-building installed base creates repeat monitoring, freeze, water, moisture, power, connectivity and security problems.
segments.supplier_gap: Old equipment + remote location + high inconvenience of ordering wrong part = high value of certainty

segments.name: Indoor air / radon / moisture
segments.thesis: Cold-climate housing and high home ownership create monitoring and remediation demand.
segments.niche: Radon monitors, moisture sensors, ventilation components
segments.supplier_gap: Generic meters don't address Norwegian-specific radon/ventilation needs

segments.name: EV aftermarket exact-model ecosystems
segments.thesis: Treat EVs as installed-base ecosystems and hunt model-specific accessories/maintenance/charging problems.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic EV accessories don't address specific model compatibility

segments.name: Home technical/capital goods
segments.thesis: High home ownership plus improving capital-goods outlook can create exact-model specialist opportunities.
segments.supplier_gap: OEM parts expensive, generic alternatives unvalidated
